scenario.description: Which text a server reads, and where its answers go (PLAN §18.1, §18.2): a hover on the old side opens that side's text at the path and says it was read against the working tree, and the document is closed once answered; Ctrl+click on the old side lands on the old side's line in the same file, not the new side's line of that number; in a staged review, a definition in another file opens the file view at the working tree (`file_view.worktree`, read-only), and Alt ← returns; screenshots of the old side's card and the working tree's file view.
